name: Festive Poodle
summary: A unique dog to scan in the garden of a Christmas-themed house on Key Lento's north seafront.
body: The Big Lead calls the Festive Poodle a unique dog to scan and places it in the garden of the Christmas-themed house in the north seafront row of Key Lento.

name: Cartoon Labrador
summary: A unique dog to scan at a party house in the south-east corner of Key Lento.
body: The Big Lead calls the Cartoon Labrador another unique dog and places it at a party house in the south-east corner of Key Lento.

name: Yorkshire Terrier
summary: A dog The Big Lead heard barking inside an abandoned laundry in north-west Belville.
body: The Big Lead mentions a barking Yorkshire Terrier inside an abandoned laundry with a blocked door at the north-west of Belville, south of the Biker Hideout.

name: Florida panther
summary: A big cat listed as Cougar/Florida Panther, seen stalking deer at Mount Kalaga and named as a hunting target.
body: Destructoid lists it as Cougar/Florida Panther among land animals.
Mashable points to a Rockstar screenshot of a cougar stalking deer at Mount Kalaga and says some hunting challenges send players after a panther.
An official Mount Kalaga image shows a cougar stalking deer at a stream. A wildcat also appears in a Grassrivers image.

name: American Alligator
summary: Leonida's alligator, which Mashable notes can eat the player.
body: Destructoid lists the American Alligator, placing it under sea animals.
Mashable names alligators among Florida-specific wildlife and says they can eat you.
The most famous attraction in Grassrivers, by Rockstar's own description.

name: Dolores
summary: Jason's pet snake at his Leonida Keys house; feeding her a mouse gives a small focus boost.
body: Mashable says Dolores is a snake living at Jason's house in the Leonida Keys, that feeding her a mouse gives him a small focus boost, and, citing Cultured Vultures, that she is the only pet Jason can keep in the story.
Polygon says the snake's terrarium stands near the kitchen in Jason's living room, and that each feeding gives 3% Focus, limited to once a day.
Polygon pairs it with the basketball hoop below the house, worth 2% Focus per basket up to five times before it resets, as early Focus boosts you lose access to once you no longer live there.
